services.name: Yoga Classes
services.desc: Yoga's incorporation of meditation and breathing can help improve a person's mental well-being. Regular yoga practice creates mental clarity and calmness, increases body awareness, relieves chronic stress patterns, relaxes the mind, centers attention, and sharpens concentration. There are many types of yoga. Vinyasa is one of the most popular styles. It is a more physical type of yoga rather than a still, meditative form. Vinyasa yoga focuses on pranayamas (breath-controlled exercises). These are followed by a series of asanas (yoga postures), which end with savasana (a resting period).
